title: Toronto Landmarks
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have a high level of physical fitness
We will start our tour at Union Station and finish at the iconic St. Lawrence Market.
*Important note* This tour consists of a lot of walking (4-5 KM's). If you tire easily, walk very slowly, or cannot walk for extended periods of time, please look at other tour providers.
This tour will not operate if there is severe weather in the forecast for the time of the tour, OR, if the temperature is above 34C or below -18C.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
I'm a Torontonian that's passionate about helping people explore the many wonderful places that it has to offer. 
The Toronto Landmarks tour will show you some of the most popular buildings/attractions in the downtown core. We will start our tour at Union Station and finish at St Lawrence Market.
I promote a positive, welcoming and inclusive atmosphere for all of my tours. 

If you enjoy tours packed with historical information/facts, this is NOT the tour for you. 

If you want to see cool things, explore interesting pockets of the city, and find out about the city's many great coffee spots/bars/resto's/patios/craft beer spots, this is the tour for you. :)

*Important notes* 
1) This tour consists of a lot of walking (4-5 KM's). If you tire easily, walk slowly or cannot walk for extended periods of time, please look at other tour providers.
2) Pics taken could be used on social media.
3) *Tours of 1-3 ppl may be combined with other tour groups during busy travel seasons.*
